hook: Cyclone *Akvan* could end Hyderabad's cold dry spell by Nov 21
hook_b: Cyclone *Akvan* could end Hyderabad's cold dry spell by Nov 21
tldr: IMD Hyderabad says Cyclone Akvan may bring rain to Telangana from Nov 20, with Hyderabad likely to see showers on Nov 21-22.

beats.what: Cyclone Akvan is expected to form over the Bay of Bengal on Nov 16-17 and cross the coast between Chennai and Bapatla, focused on south Andhra Pradesh, around Nov 19.
beats.why: After landfall, the system is forecast to push rain across Telangana from Nov 20 to 22.
beats.care: Khammam, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Mahabubabad, Suryapet, Nalgonda and Mulugu may see isolated heavy rain, lightning and gusty winds on Nov 20-21.
